text:
When I finally looked up, there was a light outside my window.

Small. Yellow. Very low, like someone was holding a lamp close to the ground at the end of my street. It did not move for a long time. Then it went out, the way the boat lamps went out in the game. Like someone walking past and blowing it out.

I still have the disc. I haven't played it since. But every night, somewhere around three, I count the lights on my street. One, two, three.

And every night, there is one more than there should be.

If you know anything about Dead Pixel Studios, or about Merrow Lake, leave it in the comments. And subscribe, because there are still more discs.
